summary_en: Daikin confirmed the post-adjustment share acquisition count for adjustment period ④ under its commitment-type share buyback (FCSR) program. The average stock price was set at 23,184.5196 yen, with 2,414,783 shares acquired, resulting in a net increase adjustment of 96,300 shares to be obtained free of charge from warrant holders.
title_en: Notice of Post-Adjustment in Commitment-Type Share Buyback (FCSR)
translation_en_brief: Daikin Industries announced the finalization of the post-adjustment share acquisition count for adjustment period ④ under its commitment-type share buyback (FCSR) program, previously announced on May 12, 2026. The average stock price for the adjustment period was determined at 23,184.5196 yen, calculated as the arithmetic mean of the volume-weighted average price (VWAP) of Daikin shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from May 14, 2026 to September 4, 2026, multiplied by 99.446 percent, with a dividend adjustment of 0 yen added. Based on this average price, 2,414,783 shares were acquired on May 13, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 from Nomura Securities. Under the post-adjustment mechanism, a net increase adjustment of 96,300 shares will be obtained free of charge from warrant holders, reflecting the difference between the number of shares that would have been acquired at the average price (2,511,176 shares) and the number actually acquired (2,414,783 shares). This adjustment is part of the six-adjustment-period FCSR program and reflects the contractual terms for periodic repricing during the commitment period.
